signals.title: Tencent publica el código abierto de DFly2: decodificación especulativa que reutiliza la caché KV dispersa del objetivo
signals.summary: Tencent lanzó DFly2, un decodificador especulativo para LLMs de atención dispersa que reutiliza la caché KV del modelo objetivo, sin memoria extra y aumenta el rendimiento hasta un 81 %.
signals.title_orig: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
signals.summary_orig: Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%. The post Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache appeared first on MarkTechPost .

signals.title_orig: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
signals.summary_orig: Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified. signals.title: OpenAI y Cisco presentan Shirudo: un entorno de ejecución Linux de código abierto que permite a los agentes defender los sistemas sin tiempo de inactividad
signals.summary: OpenAI y Cisco lanzan Shirudo, un runtime eBPF de código abierto para Linux que permite a agentes de IA crear “escudos” que bloquean vulnerabilidades sin interrumpir el sistema.
signals.title_orig: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime
signals.summary_orig: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release, BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux. AI agents write signed "shields" that block exploit paths on running systems while teams test and roll out real patches. The post OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime appeared first on MarkTechPost .
